newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH NATIONAL BANK SAYS NO BOARD MEETING THURSDAY.
newsitem.headline: CZECH NATIONAL BANK SAYS NO BOARD MEETING THURSDAY.

text.p: The Czech National Bank said on Thursday that it would not be holding a board meeting this Thursday.
The central bank regularly meets each Thursday but a press official said it would not be meeting today as the board met last Thursday and the Thursday before.

On Wednesday, the government announced a package of economic measures designed to kick-start the economy and Prime Minister Vaclav Klaus said he would like to see a relaxation of monetary policy to complement his package.
However he added that any decision would be taken by the central bank alone.
